title: resolve_owner_id reads KITHD_OWNER_ID env var twice
description: config.rs resolve_owner_id() calls std::env::var("KITHD_OWNER_ID") twice: once on line 118 (is_err() check) and again on line 125 (unwrap_or_default()). Every other resolver in this file (resolve_port, resolve_fallback_bind_addr, resolve_data_dir) reads each var exactly once. Fix: capture the Ok value from the first call and reuse it, matching the pattern used elsewhere in the file.
